documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter
Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Sheetal Universal Limited presented its Annual Report for the financial year 2024-25, highlighting operational and financial performance across standalone and consolidated segments. Total revenue for the year decreased by 22.59% compared to the previous year, while the company reported a profit after tax of Rs. 9,320.9 lakhs. Management noted positive industry outlooks in the agriculture and agro-based products segment, alongside initiatives focused on quality standards, cost reduction, and direct engagement with farmers. The board recommended a final dividend of Rs.

demand_outlook.claim: The outlook for the industry remains positive, with strong demand projected for the coming years in both domestic and international markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The outlook for the industry remains positive, with strong demand projected for the coming years, both in domestic and international markets.

demand_outlook.claim: As global and domestic markets continue to prioritize food security and sustainability, the demand for high-quality agricultural products is expected to rise substantially.
demand_outlook.quote: As global and domestic markets continue to prioritize food security and sustainability, the demand for high-quality agricultural products is expected to rise substantially.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that there is a lot of potential demand for the coming years as the company deals in agriculture-based products.
demand_outlook.quote: As ours is the agriculture based products, there is lot of potential demand for the next years.

capex_expansion.claim: New machineries were installed to provide better result and to cope up with changing requirement of the industry.
capex_expansion.quote: New machineries were installed to provide better result and to cope up with changing requirement of the industry.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors have decided to retain the entire amount of profit for F.Y. 2024-25 in the Statement of Profit & Loss as at March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors have decided to retain the entire amount of profit for F.Y. 2024-25 in the Statement of Profit & Loss as at March 31, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The directors recommend a Dividend of Rs. 0.5 (i.e. 5% per share) per equity share of face value of Rs. 10/- as Final Dividend for the financial year ended on 31st March, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: Your directors recommend a Dividend of Rs. 0.5 (i.e. 5% per share) per equity share of face value of Rs. 10/- as Final Dividend for the financial year ended on 31st March, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of your company, after considering holistically the relevant circumstances and keeping in view the Company’s dividend track, has decided that it would be prudent, not to recommend any Dividend for the year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors decided to retain the entire amount of profit for fiscal 2023-24 in the Statement of Profit & Loss.
